title: Data on Selection of HDB Blocks for Home Improvement Programme
what_it_is: Data on Selection of HDB Blocks for Home Improvement Programme

sections.label: HIP block selection and progress
sections.summary: HDB selects HIP blocks, prioritising those aged 30 and above, and will expedite projects.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Out of the 4,449 blocks selected for HIP since the programme's inception in 2007, 102 blocks are below 30 years, as at 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Generally, these blocks have been selected for HIP as they form a contiguous parcel with blocks that are 30 years and above.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: At the beginning of each Nomination Exercise to select blocks for the HIP, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) will inform Town Councils of the remaining precincts or blocks that are eligible and invite them to nominate a number of the eligible precincts and blocks, especially those that are aged 30 years and above, for HDB and the Ministry of National Development (MND)'s evaluation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In general, MND and HDB will accord priority to older flats, while ensuring that there is a good geographical spread of HIP projects across public housing estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Can I ask whether the HIP progress has been slowed by COVID-19, and if so, are there any plans to ramp up so that more HIPs can be rolled out to more precincts and more residents can benefit from it?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: However, now with the projects that are being selected, we will do our best to expedite them.

sections.label: Geographical spread of HIP
sections.summary: Geographical spread reflects HDB building history, and a spread is provided so more residents see a refresh.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As for how we look at geographical spread, this actually reflects, to a very large extent, the history of our HDB building programmes because in the past, we have been developing new towns and this results, for instance, in flats of a certain age being bunched in certain localities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: But we also know that, generally, once the flats get to a certain age, there will be reasons why residents would like to see a refresh, so we bear this in mind.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: There will be times when there are towns with more flats that are of a certain age, but we try to also provide a spread, so that more residents will be able to see a refresh going on in their estates.
